title: Youth and Seniors in Focus on Upcoming 'Caminhos da Reportagem'
seoTitle: Youth and Seniors Featured in Program
subtitle: The episode 'Do primeiro ao último voto' explores the perspective of those who still view voting as optional.
excerpt: This Monday (21) at 11:30 PM, TV Brasil will air 'Do primeiro ao último voto,' examining the significance of voting for youth and seniors.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Titled Do primeiro ao último voto, the next episode of the program Caminhos da Reportagem will air this Monday (21) at 11:30 PM on **TV Brasil**.

The program gives voice to a segment of Brazilian voters for whom voting is still considered optional, highlighting the perception of youth and seniors regarding participation at the polls.

By addressing the importance of voting for these groups, the report aims to broaden the debate on civic participation and the relevance of each vote in the democratic process.

With information from Agência Brasil.
